# Eboya

> > Eboya is an official Japanese online shop specializing in handcrafted fountain pens, ballpoint pens, and apparel with distinctive marble finishes and innovative ink-filling systems.

Eboya offers a curated collection of premium Japanese writing instruments including signature lines like HOUJU, TANSHIN, NICHIBO, and KOUGETSU, alongside complementary apparel collections. Each product features multiple color variants and size options to suit diverse preferences.
